import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_59/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, list them here
    ]

    # Initialize an empty list to hold dataframes
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file, select relevant columns, and append to dfs
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Select only the columns needed for the target: PRODUCTLINE and SALES
        df_selected = df[['PRODUCTLINE', 'SALES']]
        dfs.append(df_selected)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Group by PRODUCTLINE and sum SALES
    result_df = combined_df.groupby('PRODUCTLINE', as_index=False)['SALES'].sum()

    # Ensure SALES is float type
    result_df['SALES'] = result_df['SALES'].astype(float)

    # Write the result to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_59/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    result_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
